instruction: Fix `mode` in `numstats/descriptive.py` so that when multiple values tie for most frequent, the smallest value is returned. For `[3, 1, 3, 1]` it currently returns `3` instead of `1`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats/descriptive.py b/numstats/descriptive.py
--- a/numstats/descriptive.py
+++ b/numstats/descriptive.py
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@
     for value in data:
         counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
     max_count = max(counts.values())
-    return max(v for v, c in counts.items() if c == max_count)
+    return min(v for v, c in counts.items() if c == max_count)
